drafts.rationale: EV-O-A13 caps how many times a job may run: one original execution plus at most three retries, after which the job must not be executed again.
drafts.subject: Orion job execution

drafts.rationale: EV-O-B13 requires a fixed five-second wait before every retry, measured from the end of the failed attempt and independent of attempt number.
drafts.subject: Orion job retry

drafts.rationale: EV-O-C13 bounds each execution to half a minute and requires a stop at that limit to be recorded as a failed attempt.
drafts.subject: Orion job execution

drafts.rationale: EV-O-D13 defines when a further delivery of an active job is ignored (same job id and idempotency key) versus rejected as conflicting (same job id, different key).
drafts.subject: Orion job delivery

drafts.rationale: EV-O-E13 requires each idempotency key to be retained for twenty-four hours after first seen, after which a later delivery with that key is treated as new.
drafts.subject: Orion idempotency keys

drafts.rationale: EV-O-F13 requires a worker lease to last ninety seconds from delivery and the job to become available to other workers if the lease expires without renewal or release.
drafts.subject: Orion worker lease

drafts.rationale: EV-O-G13 specifies when a progressing worker must renew, a fifteen-second minimum between renewals, and that a renewal extends the lease by the full duration.
drafts.subject: Orion worker lease

drafts.rationale: EV-O-H13 states that cancellation blocks future attempts without aborting a running attempt, and that a repeated cancellation leaves the job cancelled without other state change.
drafts.subject: Orion job cancellation

drafts.rationale: EV-O-I13 requires an automatic move to the dead-letter queue after the final unsuccessful attempt, with no further execution unless the job is explicitly resubmitted.
drafts.subject: Orion job final failure

drafts.rationale: EV-O-J13 requires an operator escalation when three dead-letter events occur for the same tenant within one hour measured from the first of those events.
drafts.subject: Orion tenant dead-letter events

drafts.rationale: EV-O-K13 guarantees first-in-first-out execution only among jobs in the same queue partition and makes no ordering promise across partitions.
drafts.subject: Orion queue partition

drafts.rationale: EV-O-L13 requires audit history to remain queryable for thirty calendar days from recording, after which an event may be deleted.
drafts.subject: Orion audit events

drafts.rationale: EV-O-A01 and EV-O-A02 require at most three executions in total, with the first counting as one of the three.

value.text: A job must be executed at most three times in total, including the first execution; after the third execution ends without success, no further execution may be started.

drafts.rationale: EV-O-A13 allows one original execution plus no more than three retries, and forbids further execution after the third retry fails.

value.text: One original execution may be followed by at most three retry executions; once three retries have ended without success, the job must not be executed again.

drafts.rationale: EV-O-B13 requires a fixed five-second wait before every retry, independent of attempt number.

value.text: Before every retry the worker must wait exactly five seconds from the end of the failed attempt, and the wait must not vary with attempt number.

drafts.rationale: EV-O-B05 and EV-O-B07 specify exponential backoff from two seconds, doubling each retry and capped at thirty seconds.

value.text: The first retry waits two seconds from the failed execution; each later retry waits twice the previous wait, never exceeding thirty seconds.

drafts.rationale: EV-O-C13 limits an individual execution to half a minute and the example treats 12:00:00 to 12:00:30 as that limit.
EV-O-C13 requires that an execution reaching the limit is stopped and recorded as a failed attempt.

value.text: When the per-execution time limit is reached, the execution must be stopped and recorded as a failed attempt.

drafts.rationale: EV-O-D01 and EV-O-D09 ignore any further delivery that carries the same job id while that job is active, without changing its state.

value.text: While a job id is active, any further delivery with the same job id must be ignored and must not change the active job's state.

drafts.rationale: EV-O-D13 ignores a repeat only when job id and idempotency key both match, and rejects a same-id different-key delivery as conflicting without changing state.

value.text: While a job is active, a further delivery is ignored only when it has both the same job id and the same idempotency key; the same job id with a different key is rejected as conflicting input and must not change the active job's state.

drafts.rationale: EV-O-E13 requires each idempotency key to be retained for twenty-four hours after it is first seen.
EV-O-F01 and EV-O-F06 require a worker lease to last sixty seconds from delivery to the worker.
EV-O-F13 requires a worker lease to last ninety seconds from the moment the job is delivered to the worker.
EV-O-G01 and EV-O-G11 allow renewal every thirty seconds while progressing and extend the lease by the full duration from renewal.

value.text: A worker may renew its lease every thirty seconds while work is progressing, and a renewal extends the lease by the full lease duration from the moment of renewal.

drafts.rationale: EV-O-G13 requires renewal at twenty seconds remaining, rate-limits renewal to once per fifteen seconds, and extends by the full lease duration.

value.text: A worker must renew when twenty seconds of lease life remain if work is progressing, must not renew the same lease more often than once every fifteen seconds, and a renewal extends the lease by the full lease duration from the moment of renewal.

drafts.rationale: EV-O-H13 forbids later attempts after cancel, leaves a running attempt to finish on its own, and treats a repeated cancellation as a no-op on job state.

value.text: After cancellation, no future execution attempt may be started; a running attempt is not interrupted; a repeated cancellation of an already-cancelled job leaves it cancelled and otherwise unchanged.

drafts.rationale: EV-O-I13 requires automatic dead-lettering after the last failed attempt and forbids further execution unless the job is explicitly resubmitted.

value.text: After the final unsuccessful execution attempt, Orion must automatically move the job to the dead-letter queue, and a dead-lettered job must not be executed again unless explicitly resubmitted.

drafts.rationale: EV-O-J13 escalates at three dead-letter events for one tenant within a one-hour window starting at the first event.

value.text: Orion must raise an operator escalation when three dead-letter events occur for the same tenant within one hour, measured from the first of the three events.

drafts.rationale: EV-O-K13 limits the FIFO guarantee to jobs in the same partition and makes no ordering promise across partitions.

value.text: FIFO execution order is guaranteed only among jobs in the same queue partition; no ordering guarantee is made between jobs in different partitions.

drafts.rationale: EV-O-L13 requires audit history to remain queryable for one month, defined as thirty calendar days from recording, after which an event may be deleted.
